paper.title_en: Reconstructing $f(R)$ gravity from generalized entropies: exact Lagrangians
paper.abstract_en: Generalized horizon entropies are widely used as theoretical modifications of the Bekenstein-Hawking area law, but through the Wald construction they may also encode modifications of the underlying gravitational dynamics. We reconstruct metric $f(R)$ gravity from prescribed entropy-area relations and show that the procedure is intrinsically branch dependent through the required area-curvature map. On the maximally symmetric branch, where $A=48π/R$ exactly, the reconstruction reduces to a single quadrature and can be performed non-perturbatively. We obtain closed-form Lagrangians for several generalized entropies and show that an entropy term $a~S_{BH}^{q}$ generates a curvature term proportional to $R^{2-q}$. In particular, Kaniadakis entropy produces a $1/R$ correction, while logarithmic entropy generates an $R^2\ln R$ term. We further derive a branch-independent criterion, $\partial_{R}^{2} f=(ds/dR)d(S/s)/ds$, relating Dolgov-Kawasaki stability directly to the entropy functional, together with $m_{\rm sc}^2=S'(s)/(3f_{RR})$ on the maximally symmetric branch. Comparison with the fixed-mass Schwarzschild-de Sitter branch reveals different reconstructed Lagrangians and reversed stability properties. Finally, the weak-isolated-horizon boost charge reproduces the original generalized entropy. These results establish a direct non-perturbative link between generalized horizon thermodynamics and modified gravitational dynamics.

decision.title_zh: 从广义熵重建$f(R)$引力：精确拉格朗日量
decision.abstract_zh: 广义视界熵被广泛用作Bekenstein-Hawking面积定律的理论修正，但通过Wald构造，它们也可能编码底层引力动力学的修正。我们根据给定的熵-面积关系重建度规$f(R)$引力，并表明该过程从根本上依赖于分支，这通过所需的面积-曲率映射体现。在最大对称分支上，其中$A=48π/R$精确成立，重建简化为单个求积，并且可以非微扰地进行。我们获得了几种广义熵的闭式拉格朗日量，并表明熵项$a~S_{BH}^{q}$产生与$R^{2-q}$成正比的曲率项。特别是，Kaniadakis熵产生$1/R$修正，而对数熵产生$R^2\ln R$项。我们进一步推导出一个与分支无关的判据，$\partial_{R}^{2} f=(ds/dR)d(S/s)/ds$，将Dolgov-Kawasaki稳定性直接与熵泛函联系起来，并连同最大对称分支上的$m_{\rm sc}^2=S'(s)/(3f_{RR})$。与固定质量Schwarzschild-de Sitter分支的比较揭示了不同的重建拉格朗日量和相反的稳定性性质。最后，弱孤立视界提升电荷再现了原始广义熵。这些结果建立了广义视界热力学与修正引力动力学之间的直接非微扰联系。
